title: Bani Suef irrigation-suitability digital-soil-mapping repository
description:
Reproducible analysis pipeline coupling quantile-random-forest digital soil mapping, Monte Carlo Sys–Verheye ALES-Arid land evaluation, and counterfactual gap decomposition over the Beni Suef alluvial floodplain (Middle Egypt). Independent ground-truth validation against a 993-point Sentinel-2 cropland survey (March 2025) is included.

Version 1.1.0 adds the stages prepared for the Geoderma Regional first revision: a structural sensitivity analysis of the rating index (four aggregation rules, elasticities, threshold perturbation), a Gaussian-copula variant of the Monte Carlo propagation, quantification and post-stratified correction of the crop-survey sampling bias, and an independent comparison against FAO WaPOR v3 transpiration, evapotranspiration and biomass fields.

Companion code to El-Naggar et al. (2026), Geoderma Regional (under revision).
